title: A regional catalogue: the b-value
intro:
Illustrative data, made up for this book. Another region's catalogue: log₁₀ of the yearly number of earthquakes of at least magnitude M. Fit log₁₀ N = a − bM.

Give the intercept a and the slope (−b) (three decimals), and the fitted log₁₀ N at M = 6.5 (three decimals). The rate of M ≥ 6.5 earthquakes is 10 to that power each year.

In the Workbench: **Simple linear regression**, **x column** *Magnitude*, **y column** *Log10 N per year*, **Predict at x₀** 6.5.
hints: x is the magnitude, y the log₁₀ of the yearly count. b is the slope with its sign changed; b is close to 1 in most regions.
